links.outcome: Block F1 and source accuracy of automated claim-level verifier on held-out medical agent traces
links.effect: Block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 over 260 source-eligible claims on the 40-trace held-out split; outperformed source-blind baselines. Harder multi-source benchmark: block F1 0.846.
links.quote: On the 40-trace held-out split, ProvenanceGuard achieves block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 over 260 source-eligible claims, outperforming source-blind baselines that do not emit claim-to-source IDs.

links.outcome: Detection of wrong source attribution (cross-source conflation) in clinical agent answers
links.effect: Detected all injected attribution swaps in 50 clinical conflation probes with no retained wrong attribution; on a harder multi-source benchmark, source-plus-relation accuracy dropped to 0.229.
links.quote: In 50 controlled clinical conflation probes, ProvenanceGuard detects all injected attribution swaps with no retained wrong attribution.

unlisted_practices: Claim-level source-provenance verification of agent answers against captured MCP tool traces
Repair-and-reverify of blocked AI answers via retrieval-augmented revision

screen.reason: Evaluates ProvenanceGuard as an external guardrail/verifier and repair safeguard for MCP-based LLM agents on medical domain traces and clinical conflation probes.

primary.practice: source-aware factuality verification and output filtering/repair
